errors.root_cause: Public concentration and Friday/opening-match risk were recognized too late and not reflected in the primary direction.
The away scenario was excluded from every column despite a balanced match and opening-week uncertainty. This eliminated all 58 columns.
Fenerbahce was treated as a banko-like fixed away result; opening-match surprise risk and squad/rotation uncertainty were not allowed into the coverage.

system_errors: Opening/Friday risk was noted as a user signal but not converted into a formal pre-match penalty or coverage rule.
Market/public pick percentages were treated as context, not as an explicit overload-risk feature with a required draw/opposite-result review.
Balanced matches were sometimes covered with a double that omitted the opposite result; M3 1X had no 2, while M5 single 2 had no 1/X.
The live-data workflow initially over-relied on frozen pages; freshness and source disagreement were not consistently separated until later.
Column survival was previously reported from per-match coverage rather than exact column intersection; this produced the false 22-active-columns claim.
next_actions: For opening/Friday matches, require explicit 1/X/2 review before any banko or two-way cover.
For a balanced match, do not call 1X or X2 safe without documenting why the omitted result is materially less likely.
Persist full played columns before kickoff and recompute survival after every final result.
Use at least 3 independent current/final sources for post-match verification and label stale sources.
